CommunityApplications.Profile:
NetSpy is a live network monitoring dashboard for Unraid and other servers: per-interface, per-process and per-container throughput in real time (1 s sampling). One Docker image, two roles — the web dashboard polls lightweight agents on other hosts (TrueNAS, Debian, ...) via a single compose file or the Unraid GUI template.
Support: open an issue at https://github.com/thefirstmojo/netspy/issues
